html:
Question 5
?

Consider the first-order linear ODE dydx+2y=(x2−1)sinh⁡(4x). According to the method of variation of parameters, which of the following is a suitable ansatz for the particular solution yp(x)?

a
yp(x)=u(x)e−4x
b
yp(x)=u(x)e2x
c
yp(x)=u(x)e4x
d
yp(x)=u(x)e−2x
e
yp(x)=u(x)e−3x
Submit
